input_path.description: Path to input data file (CSV or Excel)

output_dir.description: Output directory for analysis results

categorical_threshold.description: Max unique values to consider categorical (default: 10)

distribution_analysis.description: Analyze distributions with Q-Q plots (default: true)

detect_class_imbalance.description: Detect class imbalance in target (default: true)

tools.name: configure_plot_style
tools.description: Configure plot styling for EDA visualizations

tools.name: feature_importance_analysis
tools.description: Run feature importance analysis and selection on a tabular CSV for classification or regression. Methods: 'rf' (Random Forest), 'f_test' (ANOVA / F-statistic), 'mutual_info', 'rfe' (Recursive Feature Elimination). Auto-detects task type and target/ID columns when not specified. Writes a `feature_importance.csv` plus one `top_<N>_features.csv` per requested cutoff, and (optionally) importance / cumulative / correlation / PCA / t-SNE plots.

output_dir.description: Directory where results, plots, and feature_importance_analysis.log are written.

target_column.description: Target column for prediction. Auto-detected from common names ('label', 'target', 'diagnosis', 'outcome', etc.) if omitted.

exclude_columns.description: Comma-separated columns to exclude from features (e.g. 'subject_id,patient_id').

auto_exclude_id_columns.description: Auto-detect and exclude ID-like columns. Default: true.

task_type.description: Task type. Auto-detected from the target if omitted.

method.description: Feature selection method. Accepts flexible names ('Random Forest', 'ANOVA', 'Mutual Information', 'RFE'). Canonical: 'rf', 'f_test', 'mutual_info', 'rfe'. Default: 'rf'.

encode_categorical.description: How to encode categorical features. Default: 'auto'.

max_onehot_cardinality.description: Max unique values for one-hot encoding when encode_categorical='auto'. Default: 10.

create_plots.description: Generate visualization plots (importance, cumulative, correlation, PCA, t-SNE). Default: true.

top_n_plot.description: Number of top features to show in importance plots. Default: 30.

tools.name: model_performance_comparison
tools.description:
This tool compares model performance between training test results and inference results
    to detect performance degradation over time or on new datasets. It identifies metrics that
    have declined and suggests fine-tuning when performance drops significantly.

class_names.description: List of class names for better reporting (optional)

decline_threshold.description: Threshold percentage for significant performance decline (default: 5%)

inference_metrics_path.description: Path to metrics.json file from inference evaluation

output_dir.description: Directory where comparison results will be saved

training_metrics_path.description: Path to test_metrics.json file from training evaluation

tools.name: pyradiomics_extract_features
tools.description: Extract radiomic features from medical images (CT, MRI, etc.) using PyRadiomics. Pairs images with segmentation masks by subject ID, supports multi-label masks and organ-subfolder layouts, and writes one CSV per label/organ. Filters accept flexible names (case-insensitive, common typos): e.g. 'log', 'square root', 'lbp', 'wavelet'. Available filters: Original, Wavelet, LoG, Exponential, Gradient, SquareRoot, LBP2D, LBP3D. If a `targets_csv` is supplied, ALL its columns (target + predictors like age, sex, tumor_size) are merged into the output CSVs.

image_dir.description: Directory containing the medical images (e.g., MRI, CT).

mask_dir.description: Directory containing the segmentation masks. Either flat (multilabel masks) or organ subfolders (binary mask per organ).

output_dir.description: Directory where extracted features and the radiomics_extraction.log will be saved.

image_types.description: Preprocessing filters to apply. Flexible names accepted (e.g., ['log', 'square root', 'lbp']). Available: Original, Wavelet, LoG, Exponential, Gradient, SquareRoot, LBP2D, LBP3D. Default: ['Original', 'Wavelet'].

feature_classes.description: Feature classes to extract (e.g., firstorder, shape, glcm, glrlm, glszm, gldm, ngtdm). Default: all available.

specific_features.description: Specific features to extract. If provided, only these features are extracted.

mask_labels.description: Specific label values to extract for. Default: all non-zero labels found in masks. Falls back to auto-detection if any specified labels don't exist.

image_pattern.description: Glob pattern for image files. Default: '*.nii.gz'.

mask_pattern.description: Glob pattern for mask files. Default: '*.nii.gz'.

normalize.description: Normalize image intensity values. Default: true.

bin_width.description: Bin width for discretizing image intensities. Default: 25.

resample.description: Resample images to isotropic voxels. Default: true.

pixel_spacing.description: Target pixel spacing for resampling [x, y, z]. Default: [1, 1, 1].

force_2d.description: Extract features slice by slice (2D) instead of 3D. Default: false.

n_workers.description: Parallel workers for processing images. Default: 1 (serial).

targets_csv.description: CSV with ground-truth labels and predictor variables. ALL columns are merged into the output. ID and target columns are auto-detected from common naming patterns (id/subject/patient; target/label/outcome).

id_column.description: Name of the ID column in targets_csv. Auto-detected if omitted.

target_column.description: Name of the target column in targets_csv. Auto-detected if omitted; placed as the 2nd column in the output.

id_pattern.description: Regex with one capture group to extract subject ID from filenames. Default: filename without extension.

tools.name: pycaret_classification
tools.description: Train and evaluate classification models using PyCaret AutoML. Compares models, tunes the top-N, blends them, runs holdout evaluation, and writes plots/interpretations to the output directory. Auto-detects the target column from common names (label, target, outcome, ...) when omitted; fuzzy-matches misspelled targets. Model names accept both PyCaret short codes (rf, et, xgboost) and full names (random forest, extra trees, extreme gradient boosting). Requires pycaret installed. ⚠ ASYNC: AutoML comparison can run for many minutes to over an hour, so this starts a BACKGROUND job and returns a job_id immediately — it does NOT block until training finishes. Poll `training_job_status` with that job_id to get progress and the final model path / holdout metrics; treat the run as in-progress until job_status reports 'completed'.

output_dir.description: Directory for the trained model, plots, and pycaret_classification.log.

target_column.description: Target column name. Auto-detected from common names if omitted.

experiment_name.description: Experiment name. Auto-generated with timestamp if omitted.

session_id.description: Random seed for reproducibility. Random if omitted.

use_gpu.description: Use GPU for training (if available). Default: false.

fix_imbalance.description: Fix class imbalance via SMOTE. Default: true.

data_split_stratify.description: Stratify the train/holdout split by target. Default: true.

data_split_shuffle.description: Shuffle data before splitting. Default: true.

preprocess.description: Apply PyCaret preprocessing pipeline. Default: true.

ignore_features.description: Comma-separated columns to ignore during training (e.g. 'patient_id,scan_date').

numeric_features.description: Comma-separated numeric feature columns. Auto-inferred if omitted.

categorical_features.description: Comma-separated categorical feature columns. Auto-inferred if omitted.

n_select.description: Top-N models to retain for tuning + blending. Default: 3.

transformation.description: Apply Yeo-Johnson transformation to numeric features. Default: false.

pca.description: Apply PCA dimensionality reduction. Default: false.

pca_components.description: PCA components: 0-1 for variance ratio, integer >1 for explicit count.

include_models.description: Comma-separated models to include (codes or full names: 'rf,xgboost' or 'random forest, extreme gradient boosting').

test_data_path.description: Optional independent test/holdout CSV. Same schema as the training CSV.

ignore_gpu_errors.description: Fall back to CPU on GPU errors. Default: true.

tools.name: pycaret_classification_inference
tools.description: Run inference using a saved PyCaret classification model. Writes a predictions CSV and, if a ground-truth column is present, computes accuracy / precision / recall / F1 / ROC-AUC plus a confusion matrix (supports binary and multiclass). Auto-detects the ground-truth column from common names if omitted.

model_path.description: Path to the saved PyCaret model (without the .pkl suffix — PyCaret adds it).

output_dir.description: Output directory. Defaults to the input file's directory.

ground_truth_column.description: Ground-truth column name. Auto-detected if omitted; metrics are skipped if not found.

tools.name: training_job_status
tools.description: Check a background training/fine-tuning job started by a training tool (these return a job_id instead of blocking). Reports whether it is still running, tails the training log (epoch/loss/metrics), and — once complete — returns the final result (model path, metrics). Poll periodically until job_status is 'completed' or 'failed'.

job_id.description: Job ID returned when the training tool was called.

job_dir.description: Alternative: full path to the job directory.

tail_lines.description: Number of training-log lines to return. Default: 60.

session_id.description: Random seed for reproducibility. Random if omitted.

data_split_stratify.description: Stratify the train/holdout split. Default: false (regression).

data_split_shuffle.description: Shuffle data before splitting. Default: true.

preprocess.description: Apply PyCaret preprocessing pipeline. Default: true.

ignore_features.description: Comma-separated columns to ignore during training (e.g. 'patient_id,scan_date').

numeric_features.description: Comma-separated numeric feature columns. Auto-inferred if omitted.

categorical_features.description: Comma-separated categorical feature columns. Auto-inferred if omitted.

n_select.description: Top-N models to retain for tuning + blending. Default: 3.

transformation.description: Apply Yeo-Johnson transformation to numeric features. Default: true (regression).

pca.description: Apply PCA dimensionality reduction. Default: false.

pca_components.description: PCA components: 0-1 for variance ratio, integer >1 for explicit count.

include_models.description: Comma-separated models to include in comparison.

exclude_models.description: Comma-separated models to exclude from comparison.

test_data_path.description: Optional independent test/holdout CSV. Same schema as the training CSV.

ignore_gpu_errors.description: Fall back to CPU on GPU errors. Default: true.

tools.description: Run inference using a saved PyCaret regression model. Writes a predictions CSV and, if a ground-truth column is present, computes RMSE / MAE / R² / explained variance / MAPE plus a residual analysis and prediction-vs-actual comparison.

model_path.description: Path to the saved PyCaret regression model (without the .pkl suffix — PyCaret adds it).

output_dir.description: Output directory. Defaults to the input file's directory.

ground_truth_column.description: Ground-truth column name. Metrics skipped if omitted/missing.

tools.name: totalsegmentator_segment
tools.description: Segment anatomical structures in CT or MR images using TotalSegmentator. Supports 171 official structures (organs, bones, vessels, muscles). Tasks ending in '_mr' target MR images; otherwise CT is assumed. `roi_subset` and `roi_subset_robust` accept natural-language organ names (e.g. 'kidneys, liver, lungs') which are auto-mapped to TotalSegmentator's naming convention. Accepts a single NIfTI file, a DICOM folder, or a folder of NIfTI files (batch mode). Statistics are off by default; enable them only when the user explicitly requests volume or intensity measurements.

input_path.description: Path to input CT/MR NIfTI image, a DICOM folder, or a folder of NIfTI files.

output_dir.description: Output directory for segmentation masks.

output_type.description: Save segmentations as NIfTI or DICOM RT Struct (default: nifti).

multilabel.description: Save one multilabel image for all classes instead of separate binary masks.

nr_threads_saving.description: Number of threads for saving segmentations.

nora_tag.description: Tag in nora as mask. Pass nora project id.

task.description: Which model to use. Tasks ending with '_mr' target MR images. Default: 'total' for CT.

roi_subset.description: Comma-separated subset of structures to save. Accepts natural language (e.g. 'kidneys, liver, lungs').

roi_subset_robust.description: Like roi_subset but uses a slower, more robust model. Accepts natural language.

statistics.description: Off by default. Set true only when the user explicitly requests volume (mm3) or intensity measurements; do not enable for segmentation-only requests. Writes statistics.json.

stats_include_incomplete.description: Only applies when statistics=true. By default, masks within three voxels of any boundary on the statistics grid are excluded and receive zero volume/intensity, even if masks are nonempty. Set true to measure the visible portion of incomplete organs; these are not whole-organ measurements.

crop_path.description: Custom path to masks used for cropping. Defaults to output_dir.

body_seg.description: Do initial rough body segmentation and crop image to body region.

force_split.description: Process image in 3 chunks for less memory consumption.

no_derived_masks.description: Do not create derived masks (e.g. skin from body mask).

license_number.description: License number for TotalSegmentator (for non-public tasks).

tools.name: nnunet_prepare_dataset
tools.description: Build an nnU-Net v2 dataset from raw image and mask folders. Auto-detects label classes (scans masks for unique non-zero values) and channel layout (per-case subdirs / flat with modality suffix / single-file / already-formatted). Writes the Dataset{ID}_{Name}/{imagesTr,labelsTr,imagesTs}/ tree, calls the official generate_dataset_json helper, and registers a friendly model_name in <root>/models.json so later training and inference can be addressed by name. Symlinks raw files by default; pass copy=true to materialize.

images_dir.description: Folder containing the training images. Layout is auto-detected.

labels_dir.description: Folder containing segmentation masks named `{case}.{ext}`. The set of cases here defines the dataset.

dataset_name.description: Short slug-friendly name (e.g. 'LiverTumor'). Used in the on-disk Dataset{ID}_{Name} folder name and as the default model_name.

nnunet_root.description: nnU-Net workspace root. The toolkit owns this directory and creates nnUNet_raw/preprocessed/results/custom_trainers/jobs subdirs inside it. If omitted, falls back to the RECO_NNUNET_ROOT env var (set by Settings) and finally to ~/.reco/nnunet.

model_name.description: Friendly name to register in models.json (e.g. 'liver_seg_v1'). Defaults to dataset_name. Used by nnunet_train and nnunet_predict instead of the numeric dataset_id.

images_test_dir.description: Optional folder of test/holdout images (no labels needed). Auto-staged into imagesTs/.

channel_names.description: Override auto-detected channel names (e.g. ['T1','T2','FLAIR']). Length must match the detected channel count.

label_names.description: Override auto-detected labels, e.g. {"liver":1,"tumor":2}. Background is added automatically. Auto-detection is used if omitted.

file_ending.description: Override the file extension (default: auto-detected from the labels folder, usually '.nii.gz').

copy.description: Copy files instead of symlinking. Default: false (symlink for speed/disk).

overwrite.description: Allow overwriting an existing dataset folder or model_name registry entry. Default: false.

tools.name: nnunet_preprocess
tools.description: Run `nnUNetv2_plan_and_preprocess` on a registered model. Sets the three nnU-Net env vars from `nnunet_root` so the user never has to. Verifies dataset integrity by default.

model_name.description: Registered model_name (preferred). Either this or dataset_id is required.

nnunet_root.description: nnU-Net workspace root. The toolkit owns this directory and creates nnUNet_raw/preprocessed/results/custom_trainers/jobs subdirs inside it. If omitted, falls back to the RECO_NNUNET_ROOT env var (set by Settings) and finally to ~/.reco/nnunet.

configuration.description: Limit preprocessing to one configuration. Default: all.

tools.name: nnunet_train
tools.description: Train a registered model. Accepts an arbitrary epoch count: uses one of nnU-Net's built-in trainer variants (nnUNetTrainer_{1,5,10,20,50,100,250,500,750,2000,4000,8000}epochs) when possible; otherwise synthesizes a one-line subclass into <root>/custom_trainers/ and points nnU-Net at it via the nnUNet_extTrainer env var (no source-tree patching). Runs in the background via Popen + start_new_session, so the training process survives MCP restarts. Returns a job_id immediately; poll `nnunet_job_status` for progress.

nnunet_root.description: nnU-Net workspace root. The toolkit owns this directory and creates nnUNet_raw/preprocessed/results/custom_trainers/jobs subdirs inside it. If omitted, falls back to the RECO_NNUNET_ROOT env var (set by Settings) and finally to ~/.reco/nnunet.

epochs.description: Training epochs. Default: 50. Production runs typically want >=250.

continue_training.description: Resume from latest checkpoint. Default: false.

val_best.description: Use checkpoint_best for final validation. Default: false.

npz.description: Save softmax predictions as npz (needed for ensembling).

pretrained_weights.description: Path to a .pth checkpoint to initialize from.

tools.name: nnunet_predict
tools.description: Run inference using a trained model. Accepts model_name (preferred — looks up dataset_id, configuration, trainer, channel_names from the registry) or an explicit dataset_id. Auto-stages input filenames into nnU-Net's `{case}_{XXXX}.ext` format if needed (handles flat single-file dirs and per-case subdirs).

output_dir.description: Folder where segmentation masks will be written.

nnunet_root.description: nnU-Net workspace root. The toolkit owns this directory and creates nnUNet_raw/preprocessed/results/custom_trainers/jobs subdirs inside it. If omitted, falls back to the RECO_NNUNET_ROOT env var (set by Settings) and finally to ~/.reco/nnunet.

folds.description: Comma-separated fold list, or 'all'. Default: registry-derived (last trained fold).

disable_tta.description: Disable test-time augmentation (faster, less accurate). Default: false.

save_probabilities.description: Save softmax outputs (needed for ensembling). Default: false.

tools.name: nnunet_job_status
tools.description: Read a training job's metadata and tail its log. Detects whether the process is still alive, marks it completed if the checkpoint_final.pth appeared, parses last reported epoch / dice / losses from the log.

job_dir.description: Alternative: full path to the job directory.

nnunet_root.description: nnU-Net workspace root. The toolkit owns this directory and creates nnUNet_raw/preprocessed/results/custom_trainers/jobs subdirs inside it. If omitted, falls back to the RECO_NNUNET_ROOT env var (set by Settings) and finally to ~/.reco/nnunet.

tail_lines.description: Number of log lines to return. Default: 50.

tools.name: nnunet_register_model
tools.description: Import an ALREADY-TRAINED nnU-Net v2 model (downloaded, or trained elsewhere) so it can be used by nnunet_predict via a friendly model_name — no manual editing of models.json or the workspace. Point model_path at the model's Dataset{ID}_{Name} results folder (or its parent, or a specific {trainer}__{plans}__{config} subfolder). Auto-detects dataset id/name, configuration(s), trained folds, and reads dataset.json for labels/channels; copies (or symlinks) the model into the workspace's nnUNet_results and writes the registry entry. Use this before nnunet_predict whenever the model isn't one you trained here with nnunet_train.

model_path.description: Path to the trained model: the Dataset{ID}_{Name} folder, its parent directory, or a {trainer}__{plans}__{configuration} subfolder.

model_name.description: Friendly name to register (used later by nnunet_predict). Defaults to the dataset name.

nnunet_root.description: nnU-Net workspace root. The toolkit owns this directory and creates nnUNet_raw/preprocessed/results/custom_trainers/jobs subdirs inside it. If omitted, falls back to the RECO_NNUNET_ROOT env var (set by Settings) and finally to ~/.reco/nnunet.

configuration.description: Which configuration to register if the model contains more than one. Defaults to the only one present, else prefers 3d_fullres.

copy.description: Copy the model into the workspace (default true). Pass false to symlink instead (falls back to copy if symlinks aren't permitted, e.g. on Windows without admin).

overwrite.description: Replace an existing registry entry / workspace folder of the same name. Default false.

tools.name: nnunet_list_models
tools.description: List every model registered in <nnunet_root>/models.json. Each entry includes dataset_id, configuration, trainer, channel_names, labels, num_training, num_test, folds_trained, and creation timestamp.

nnunet_root.description: nnU-Net workspace root. The toolkit owns this directory and creates nnUNet_raw/preprocessed/results/custom_trainers/jobs subdirs inside it. If omitted, falls back to the RECO_NNUNET_ROOT env var (set by Settings) and finally to ~/.reco/nnunet.

tools.name: pytorch_resnet_training
tools.description:
This tool trains a ResNet model using PyTorch for medical image classification.
    It can train from scratch or fine-tune a pre-trained model, and includes validation metrics
    with configurable data augmentation and comprehensive class imbalance handling for both
    binary and multiclass classification problems.

⚠ ASYNC: This starts a background training job and returns a job_id immediately — it does NOT wait for training to finish. Poll `training_job_status` with that job_id to track progress and get the final metrics / model path. Treat the run as in-progress until job_status reports status 'completed'.

class_weights.description: Custom class weights as dictionary {class_id: weight} or 'balanced' for automatic calculation

custom_augmentations.description: Custom augmentation settings when augmentation_level is 'custom'

data_dir.description: Directory containing dataset with training and validation folders

focal_loss_alpha.description: Alpha parameter for focal loss (class weighting factor)

focal_loss_gamma.description: Gamma parameter for focal loss (focusing parameter)

handle_class_imbalance.description: Whether to apply class imbalance handling techniques

model_type.description: ResNet model type: resnet18, resnet34, resnet50, resnet101, or resnet152

output_dir.description: Directory where the trained model and results will be saved

patience.description: Number of epochs to wait before early stopping

sampling_strategy.description: Sampling strategy for over/undersampling: 'auto', 'minority', 'majority', 'not_minority', 'not_majority', or dict

num_classes.description: Number of classes (needed if not provided in config file)

device.description: Compute device: 'auto' (GPU if available, else CPU), 'gpu', or 'cpu'.

input_path.description: Path to an abdominal CT as a NIfTI file (.nii / .nii.gz), OR a folder of NIfTI files for batch processing. Volumes are auto-resampled to 1.5x1.5x3mm, HU-windowed to [-1000,1000] and cropped/padded to 224x224x160 by Merlin's preprocessing.

tools.name: merlin_check_job
tools.description: Poll a long-running Merlin job. Returns status (running/done/failed), recent log lines, and the parsed result when done. Set wait_seconds > 0 to block server-side until the job finishes OR the wait elapses (capped 300s) — cheaper than tight polling. If it returns status='running' after the wait, just call again.

job_id.description: Job ID returned by a previous Merlin tool call.

wait_seconds.description: Block server-side up to this many seconds (max 300). 0 = return immediately.

tools.name: merlin_list_jobs
tools.description: List all jobs spawned by the Merlin server with their status.
